<!-- DEMO · negocio y datos ficticios · plantilla comida de Web Creator 360 -->
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" class="lang-en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<!-- slot: seo -->
<title>Doña Rosa Kitchen · Mexican home cooking & catering in Bridgeport, CT</title>
<meta name="description" content="Homemade Mexican food in Bridgeport, CT: tacos, enchiladas, weekend pozole, breakfast and aguas frescas. Takeout and catering for parties, offices and quinceañeras. Hablamos español.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#231814">
<script>document.documentElement.classList.add('js');</script>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://images.unsplash.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght,SOFT,WONK@0,9..144,300..700,0..100,0..1;1,9..144,300..700,0..100,0..1&family=Instrument+Sans:ital,wght@0,400..700;1,400..700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* =====================================================================
     CONCEPT: "La carta de la casa" — a Puebla home kitchen on East Main
     Street, told like a good printed restaurant menu: warm masa paper,
     chile-red ink, marigold details, dotted leaders and numbered dishes,
     and close, appetizing food photography under one warm evening grade.
     ===================================================================== */

  /* ============ Tokens: recolor the template here ============ */
  :root{
    --brand:#9A2E1B;          /* chile guajillo */
    --brand-ink:#7A2214;      /* darker chile: hover, brand text */
    --brand-deep:#5E1B10;     /* footer */
    --brand-soft:#F1DDCF;
    --accent:#D99A2B;         /* cempasúchil / marigold (decorative) */
    --accent-light:#EDBC62;   /* marigold for text on dark */
    --mole:#2A1C16;           /* dark section (catering) */
    --mole-2:#3A2820;
    --bg:#F4ECE0;             /* masa */
    --paper:#FBF7F0;          /* menu paper */
    --paper-2:#EDE3D4;
    --ink:#231814;
    --ink-2:#3B2C24;
    --muted:#6B5A4D;
    --line:#E0D2BF;
    --line-strong:#C5B198;
    --green:#4B6A3B;          /* vegetarian mark */
    --on-dark:#F3EADB;
    --on-dark-muted:#CDBCA9;
    --on-dark-line:rgba(243,234,219,.18);

    --font-display:"Fraunces", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --font-body:"Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
    --radius:4px;
    --header-h:84px;
    --header-s:64px;
    --tabs-h:58px;
    --wrap:1320px;
    --gutter:40px;
    --grade:saturate(.9) contrast(1.05) sepia(.12) brightness(.98);
    --grain:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='180' height='180'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .16 0 0 0 0 .1 0 0 0 0 .06 0 0 0 .09 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
  }

  *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
  html:focus-within{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{margin:0;background:var(--bg) var(--grain);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:18px;line-height:1.62;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
  img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
  a{color:inherit}
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;line-height:1.04;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 40,"WONK" 0;text-wrap:balance}
  p{margin:0;text-wrap:pretty}
  ul,ol{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
  button{font:inherit;color:inherit}
  em{font-style:italic}
  .lang-en [data-es], .lang-es [data-en]{display:none !important}
  .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;padding:0 var(--gutter)}
  section[id]{scroll-margin-top:var(--header-s)}
  .cat[id]{scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--header-s) + var(--tabs-h) + 8px)}
  .skip{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:4px;z-index:200;text-decoration:none}
  .skip:focus{top:12px}
  .ph{filter:var(--grade)}
  .tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}

  /* ============ Type helpers ============ */
  .kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brand-ink);margin-bottom:26px}
  .kicker .no{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;font-size:17px;color:var(--brand)}
  .kicker .rule{width:36px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.5}
  .h2{font-size:clamp(2.6rem,1.4rem + 3.6vw,4.6rem);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 50,"WONK" 0}
  .h2 em{color:var(--brand);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1}
  .lede{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,.95rem + .35vw,1.2rem);color:var(--muted);max-width:56ch;margin-top:22px}

  /* ============ Buttons & links ============ */
  .btn{--b:var(--brand);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6em;min-height:52px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;letter-spacing:.005em;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .25s var(--ease),color .25s var(--ease),border-color .25s var(--ease);white-space:nowrap}
  .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke-width:1.8;flex-shrink:0}
  .btn .arr{transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
  .btn:hover .arr{transform:translateX(4px)}
  .btn:hover .arr-ur{transform:translate(2px,-2px)}
  .btn-primary{background:var(--brand);color:#FFF8F0}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--brand-ink)}
  .btn-ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
  .btn-ink:hover{background:var(--brand-ink)}
  .btn-outline{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
  .btn-outline:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
  .btn-light{background:var(--on-dark);color:var(--mole)}
  .btn-light:hover{background:#fff}
  .btn-ghost-light{border-color:rgba(243,234,219,.5);color:var(--on-dark)}
  .btn-ghost-light:hover{border-color:var(--on-dark);background:rgba(243,234,219,.1)}
  .ulink{background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100%/100% 1px no-repeat;text-decoration:none;padding-bottom:3px;transition:background-size .45s var(--ease)}
  .ulink:hover{background-size:0 1px;background-position:100% 100%}
  .link-arrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.45em;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
  .link-arrow svg{width:17px;height:17px;transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
  .link-arrow:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}

  /* ============ Header ============ */
  .site-header{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:80;color:var(--on-dark);transition:background-color .35s var(--ease),color .35s var(--ease),box-shadow .35s var(--ease)}
  .js .site-header{position:fixed}
  .site-header.solid{background:rgba(251,247,240,.97);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
  .header-inner{height:var(--header-h);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:36px;transition:height .35s var(--ease)}
  .site-header.solid .header-inner{height:var(--header-s)}
  .logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;flex-shrink:0}
  .logo svg{width:42px;height:42px;flex-shrink:0;transition:width .35s var(--ease),height .35s var(--ease)}
  .site-header.solid .logo svg{width:36px;height:36px}
  .logo-word{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1}
  .logo-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:25px;letter-spacing:-.015em;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 0}
  .logo-sub{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75;margin-top:5px}
  .nav{display:flex;gap:30px;margin-left:auto}
  .nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:15.5px;padding:6px 0;background:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor) 0 100%/0 1px no-repeat;transition:background-size .4s var(--ease)}
  .nav a:hover{background-size:100% 1px}
  .header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
  .header-phone{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .header-phone svg{width:16px;height:16px}
  .lang-switch{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:999px;padding:3px;opacity:.95}
  .lang-switch button{border:0;background:transparent;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;cursor:pointer;min-width:38px;opacity:.75;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s,opacity .2s}
  .lang-switch button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:currentColor;opacity:1}
  .lang-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] span{color:var(--ink)}
  .site-header.solid .lang-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] span{color:var(--paper)}
  .header-cta{min-height:44px;padding:0 20px;font-size:15px}
  .site-header:not(.solid) .header-cta{background:var(--on-dark);color:var(--ink)}
  .site-header:not(.solid) .header-cta:hover{background:#fff}
  .menu-toggle{position:relative;display:none;border:0;background:transparent;width:46px;height:46px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;border-radius:50%;margin-right:-8px}
  .menu-toggle svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke-width:1.6}
  .menu-toggle .i-close{display:none}
  .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .i-open{display:none}
  .menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .i-close{display:block}
  .mobile-nav{display:none}

  /* ============ Hero ============ */
  .hero{position:relative;min-height:max(680px,100svh);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;color:var(--on-dark);background:var(--mole)}
  .hero-media{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
  .hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 58%;animation:settle 2.2s var(--ease) both}
  .hero-media::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
      linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(26,16,11,.78) 0%,rgba(26,16,11,.5) 38%,rgba(26,16,11,.08) 70%),
      linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(26,16,11,.88) 0%,rgba(26,16,11,.35) 34%,rgba(26,16,11,0) 58%),
      linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(26,16,11,.55) 0%,rgba(26,16,11,0) 22%)}
  .hero-inner{position:relative;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:end;gap:48px;padding-top:calc(var(--header-h) + 40px);padding-bottom:36px}
  .status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.01em;padding:8px 16px 8px 13px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(243,234,219,.35);background:rgba(26,16,11,.35);margin-bottom:30px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .status .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#7BC08A;position:relative;flex-shrink:0}
  .status .dot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-4px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #7BC08A;opacity:0;animation:ping 2.6s var(--ease) infinite}
  .status.closed .dot{background:var(--accent-light)}
  .status.closed .dot::after{display:none}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,1rem + 5.4vw,6.6rem);line-height:.97;letter-spacing:-.028em;max-width:10.5ch;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 30,"WONK" 0;font-weight:380}
  .lang-es .hero h1{max-width:12ch}
  .hero h1 em{color:var(--accent-light);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1;font-weight:350}
  .hero-lede{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,.95rem + .4vw,1.2rem);max-width:46ch;margin-top:26px;color:rgba(243,234,219,.88)}
  .hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:34px}
  .hero-actions .btn{min-height:56px;padding:0 28px}
  .hero-copy > *{animation:rise .9s var(--ease) both}
  .hero-copy > :nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}
  .hero-copy > :nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s}
  .hero-copy > :nth-child(4){animation-delay:.36s}
  .ticket{animation:rise .9s .5s var(--ease) both}
  .hero-foot{position:relative;border-top:1px solid rgba(243,234,219,.2)}
  .hero-foot .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding-top:18px;padding-bottom:22px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(243,234,219,.78)}
  .hero-foot span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
  .hero-foot svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke-width:1.6}
  .hero-foot a{text-decoration:none}

  /* weekend ticket */
  .ticket{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:center;width:360px;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);padding:14px 22px 14px 14px;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
  .ticket::before,.ticket::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:120px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:#2a1b14}
  .ticket::before{top:-7px}
  .ticket::after{bottom:-7px}
  .ticket img{width:92px;height:92px;object-fit:cover;object-position:30% 50%;border-radius:3px}
  .ticket-body{border-left:1px dashed var(--line-strong);padding-left:18px}
  .ticket small{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brand)}
  .ticket strong{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:25px;line-height:1.1;margin:5px 0 4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .ticket strong b{font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .ticket .sub{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4;display:block}

  /* ============ Intro / house notes ============ */
  .intro{padding:136px 0 120px}
  .intro-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);gap:96px;align-items:start}
  .intro-statement{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(1.9rem,1.2rem + 1.9vw,3.05rem);line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.018em;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 60,"WONK" 0;text-wrap:pretty}
  .intro-statement em{color:var(--brand);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1}
  .intro-sign{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:34px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
  .intro-sign svg{width:54px;height:30px;color:var(--brand)}
  .notes{border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .notes li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .notes .n{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:17px;color:var(--brand);padding-top:1px}
  .notes strong{display:block;font-weight:600;font-size:17px;line-height:1.35}
  .notes span.t{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:3px}
  .notes li.es-badge strong{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--brand-ink)}

  /* ============ Menu (signature) ============ */
  .menu{padding:40px 0 136px}
  .menu-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);gap:96px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:56px}
  .menu-head .lede{margin-top:0}
  .legend{display:flex;gap:20px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:18px}
  .legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .legend svg{width:16px;height:16px}
  .ico-hot{color:var(--brand)}
  .ico-veg{color:var(--green)}

  .menu-tabs{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:40;background:rgba(244,236,224,.97);border-top:1px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .js .menu-tabs{top:var(--header-s)}
  .menu-tabs ul{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;height:var(--tabs-h);align-items:stretch}
  .menu-tabs ul::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
  .menu-tabs li{scroll-snap-align:start;display:flex}
  .menu-tabs a{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;padding:0 18px;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s}
  .menu-tabs li:first-child a{padding-left:0}
  .menu-tabs a .r{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:14px;color:var(--brand);opacity:.8}
  .menu-tabs a .nm{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .menu-tabs a .en{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em}
  .menu-tabs a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:-1px;height:2px;background:var(--brand);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
  .menu-tabs li:first-child a::after{left:0}
  .menu-tabs a:hover,.menu-tabs a.active{color:var(--ink)}
  .menu-tabs a.active::after{transform:scaleX(1)}

  .menu-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,400px);gap:64px;align-items:start;margin-top:48px}
  .carta{background:var(--paper) var(--grain);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:56px 64px 44px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line),0 40px 60px -50px rgba(35,24,20,.35)}
  .carta::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);pointer-events:none}
  .carta-mast{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;justify-content:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px;text-align:center}
  .carta-mast::before,.carta-mast::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line-strong)}
  .carta-mast svg{width:26px;height:16px;color:var(--brand)}
  .cat{padding-top:48px}
  .cat + .cat{margin-top:16px}
  .cat-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;padding-bottom:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .cat-head .r{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:20px;color:var(--brand);min-width:28px}
  .cat-head h3{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,1.6rem + 1.4vw,3rem);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 60,"WONK" 0}
  .cat-head .sub{margin-left:auto;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:right}
  .cat-note{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink-2);margin:16px 0 6px 44px;max-width:52ch;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 0}
  .cat-photo{display:none}
  .dishes{margin-left:44px}
  .dish{position:relative;padding:18px 0 16px;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line-strong)}
  .dish:last-child{border-bottom:0}
  .dish::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-44px;top:18px;bottom:16px;width:2px;background:var(--brand);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top;transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
  .dish.is-active::before{transform:scaleY(1)}
  .dish-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
  .dish-no{position:absolute;left:-44px;top:23px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.04em;padding-left:10px}
  .dish-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:23px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 50,"WONK" 0;text-align:left}
  button.dish-name{background:none;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;transition:color .25s}
  button.dish-name:hover,.dish.is-active button.dish-name{color:var(--brand-ink)}
  .dish-name .cam{display:none;width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--muted);align-self:center;stroke-width:1.6}
  .dish-tags{display:inline-flex;gap:5px;align-self:center}
  .dish-tags svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke-width:1.8}
  .dots{flex:1;min-width:20px;border-bottom:1.5px dotted var(--line-strong);transform:translateY(-6px)}
  .price{font-weight:600;font-size:17px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;white-space:nowrap}
  .price small{font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
  .dish-desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;margin-top:4px;max-width:56ch;line-height:1.5}
  .dish-note{display:inline-block;margin-top:9px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--brand);border:1px solid currentColor;padding:3px 8px 2px;border-radius:2px}
  .dish-fig{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .5s var(--ease)}
  .dish-fig > div{overflow:hidden}
  .dish-fig img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:3px;margin-top:14px}
  .dish.open .dish-fig{grid-template-rows:1fr}
  .carta-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 28px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:40px;padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .carta-foot p{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch}

  .preview{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--header-s) + var(--tabs-h) + 32px)}
  .preview-frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper-2);border-radius:3px}
  .preview-frame img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:0;transform:scale(1.04);transition:opacity .6s var(--ease),transform 1.4s var(--ease)}
  .preview-frame img.show{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
  .preview-tag{position:absolute;left:14px;top:14px;z-index:2;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 10px 5px;border-radius:2px}
  .preview-cap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:4px 18px;align-items:baseline;padding:20px 2px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:18px}
  .pv-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:28px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.015em;font-weight:400}
  .pv-price{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .pv-desc{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;min-height:3em}
  .preview-hint{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
  .preview-hint svg{width:15px;height:15px}

  /* ============ Catering (dark) ============ */
  .catering{background:var(--mole);color:var(--on-dark);padding:136px 0 128px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
  .catering::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--grain);opacity:.6;pointer-events:none}
  .catering .kicker{color:var(--accent-light)}
  .catering .kicker .no{color:var(--accent-light)}
  .catering .h2 em{color:var(--accent-light)}
  .catering-top{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,6fr) minmax(0,6fr);gap:80px;align-items:center}
  .catering-lede{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,.95rem + .35vw,1.2rem);color:var(--on-dark-muted);margin-top:26px;max-width:46ch}
  .catering-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:38px}
  .catering-photo{position:relative;margin:0 calc(-1 * max(var(--gutter), (100vw - var(--wrap)) / 2 + var(--gutter))) 0 0}
  .catering-photo img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:5/4;object-fit:cover;border-radius:3px 0 0 3px;filter:saturate(.74) contrast(1.05) sepia(.14) brightness(.95)}
  .catering-photo figcaption{margin-top:14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--on-dark-muted);font-style:italic;font-family:var(--font-display)}

  .invites{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:28px;margin-top:112px}
  .invite{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--paper) var(--grain);color:var(--ink);border-radius:6px;transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
  .invite:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
  .invite-top{padding:34px 34px 24px;flex:1}
  .invite-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
  .invite-meta .no{color:var(--brand)}
  .invite h3{font-size:44px;margin-top:26px;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 70,"WONK" 0}
  .invite .for{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:17px;color:var(--brand-ink);margin-top:6px;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 0}
  .invite ul{margin-top:22px;display:grid;gap:10px}
  .invite li{position:relative;padding-left:20px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink-2)}
  .invite li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.62em;width:9px;height:1px;background:var(--brand)}
  .invite-stub{position:relative;padding:22px 34px 28px;border-top:1.5px dashed var(--line-strong)}
  .invite-stub::before,.invite-stub::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-10px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mole)}
  .invite-stub::before{left:-10px}
  .invite-stub::after{right:-10px}
  .invite-price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:34px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
  .invite-price small{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--muted)}
  .invite-min{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
  .invite-cta{margin-top:18px;color:var(--brand-ink)}

  .steps-wrap{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,8fr);gap:80px;margin-top:112px;padding-top:48px;border-top:1px solid var(--on-dark-line)}
  .steps-wrap h3{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,1.4rem + 1vw,2.5rem)}
  .steps-wrap .aside-p{color:var(--on-dark-muted);font-size:16px;margin-top:14px;max-width:34ch}
  .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:40px;counter-reset:s}
  .step .n{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:56px;line-height:1;color:var(--accent-light);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1}
  .step strong{display:block;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--on-dark-line)}
  .step span.t{display:block;color:var(--on-dark-muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.55;margin-top:6px}

  /* ============ Story ============ */
  .story{padding:144px 0 136px}
  .story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,6fr);gap:112px;align-items:center}
  .portrait{margin:0;position:relative}
  .portrait .arch{border-radius:999px 999px 4px 4px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5.2}
  .portrait img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:32% 50%;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
  .portrait:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
  .portrait figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-top:14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
  .portrait figcaption i{font-family:var(--font-display)}
  .seal{position:absolute;right:-44px;top:36%;width:128px;height:128px;color:var(--brand)}
  .seal svg{width:100%;height:100%;animation:spin 40s linear infinite}
  .story-text p.body{margin-top:22px;font-size:18px;max-width:56ch}
  .facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));margin-top:48px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .facts div{padding:18px 20px 0 0}
  .facts div + div{padding-left:20px;border-left:1px solid var(--line)}
  .facts dt{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:34px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
  .facts dd{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}

  .kitchen{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr);gap:72px;margin-top:136px;align-items:end}
  .kitchen-main{margin:0 0 0 calc(-1 * max(var(--gutter), (100vw - var(--wrap)) / 2 + var(--gutter)))}
  .kitchen-main .img{overflow:hidden;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
  .kitchen-main img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 86%;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
  .kitchen-main:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
  .kitchen figcaption{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
  .kitchen figcaption b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
  .kitchen-main figcaption{padding-left:max(var(--gutter), (100vw - var(--wrap)) / 2 + var(--gutter))}
  .quote{margin:0}
  .quote blockquote{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,1.2rem + 1.6vw,2.75rem);line-height:1.18;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--ink);font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1;text-wrap:balance;position:relative}
  .quote blockquote::before{content:"\201C";display:block;font-size:4.5em;line-height:.6;height:.42em;color:var(--accent);font-style:normal}
  .quote .sign{margin-top:18px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
  .kitchen-small{margin:56px 0 0;max-width:360px}
  .kitchen-small .img{overflow:hidden;border-radius:3px}
  .kitchen-small img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:5/4;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
  .kitchen-small:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}

  /* ============ Reviews (optional) ============ */
  .reviews{background:var(--paper) var(--grain);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:120px 0}
  .reviews-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,8fr);gap:96px;align-items:start}
  .g-score{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;margin-top:40px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .g-score b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:88px;line-height:.85;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
  .g-score .meta{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
  .stars{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;color:#C98A1A}
  .stars svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:currentColor;stroke-width:0}
  .g-mark{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
  .review-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 56px}
  .review{padding:30px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .review:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px solid var(--ink);padding-top:28px}
  .review p{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:21px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:14px;letter-spacing:-.005em;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 80,"WONK" 0}
  .review:first-child p{font-size:clamp(1.6rem,1.2rem + 1vw,2.2rem);line-height:1.25;font-style:italic;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1;max-width:30ch}
  .review footer{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
  .review footer b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

  /* ============ Visit ============ */
  .visit{padding:144px 0 128px}
  .visit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:96px;align-items:start}
  .address{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(2rem,1.5rem + 1.3vw,2.8rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-top:36px}
  .address-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;margin-top:10px}
  .status-line{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:40px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .status-line .dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2F7D4A;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(47,125,74,.15)}
  .status-line.closed .dot{background:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(154,46,27,.14)}
  .hours{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:16px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .hours th,.hours td{text-align:left;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:16.5px}
  .hours th{font-weight:500}
  .hours td{text-align:right}
  .hours tr.today th,.hours tr.today td{font-weight:700;color:var(--brand-ink)}
  .hours tr.today th{position:relative}
  .today-tag{display:inline-block;margin-left:12px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#FFF8F0;background:var(--brand);padding:3px 7px 2px;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:2px}
  .hours .closed-day td{color:var(--muted)}
  .hours-note{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:16px}
  .map-frame{position:relative;background:var(--paper);padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
  .map-frame iframe{width:100%;height:440px;border:0;display:block;filter:sepia(.18) saturate(.85)}
  .map-pin{position:absolute;left:28px;bottom:28px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:3px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.35;max-width:260px}
  .map-pin b{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:19px}
  .how{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:32px;margin-top:40px}
  .how-item svg{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--brand);stroke-width:1.5}
  .how-item strong{display:block;margin-top:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:16.5px}
  .how-item > span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
  .visit-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:40px}
  .towns{margin-top:48px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .towns h3{font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
  .town-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 0;margin-top:12px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:21px;line-height:1.5}
  .town-list li:not(:last-child)::after{content:"·";margin:0 .5em;color:var(--accent)}
  .towns p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;margin-top:10px}

  /* ============ FAQ ============ */
  .faq{padding:24px 0 136px}
  .faq-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:96px}
  .faq-head{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--header-s) + 40px);align-self:start}
  .faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .faq details:first-child{border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:26px 0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:23px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.01em;transition:color .25s}
  .faq summary:hover{color:var(--brand-ink)}
  .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  .pm{position:relative;width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0}
  .pm::before,.pm::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:1.5px;margin-top:-.75px;background:var(--brand);transition:transform .4s var(--ease)}
  .pm::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
  .faq details[open] .pm::after{transform:rotate(0)}
  .faq .answer{padding:0 56px 28px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:17px;max-width:62ch}

  /* ============ Contact ============ */
  .contact{background:var(--paper-2) var(--grain);padding:136px 0}
  .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,6fr);gap:96px;align-items:start}
  .contact-lines{margin-top:48px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}
  .contact-line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) 20px;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong);text-decoration:none}
  .contact-line > svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--brand);stroke-width:1.6}
  .contact-line strong{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:24px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .contact-line div > span{display:block;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--muted)}
  .contact-line .go{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--ink);transition:transform .35s var(--ease)}
  .contact-line:hover .go{transform:translateX(4px)}
  .contact-line:hover strong{color:var(--brand-ink)}
  .form{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:48px;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 40px 60px -50px rgba(35,24,20,.4)}
  .form h3{font-size:34px}
  .form > p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;font-size:15.5px}
  .form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px 20px;margin-top:32px}
  .field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
  .field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
  .field label{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-2)}
  .field label small{font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
  .field input,.field select,.field textarea{font:inherit;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:0;padding:10px 0 11px;min-height:48px;width:100%;transition:border-color .25s var(--ease)}
  .field select{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;cursor:pointer;padding-right:28px;background:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='14' height='14' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%239A2E1B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='m6 9 6 6 6-6'/></svg>") right 2px center/14px no-repeat}
  .field textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical;border:1.5px solid var(--line-strong);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:3px;margin-top:4px}
  .field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{color:#9C8B7C}
  .field input:hover,.field select:hover,.field textarea:hover{border-color:var(--muted)}
  .field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 1.5px 0 var(--brand)}
  .field textarea:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--brand)}
  .form .btn{margin-top:30px;width:100%}
  .form-fine{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;text-align:center}

  /* ============ Footer ============ */
  .site-footer{background:var(--brand-deep);color:#EFDFCF;padding:104px 0 0;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
  .site-footer::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--grain);opacity:.8;pointer-events:none}
  .foot-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1.2fr;gap:56px}
  .site-footer .logo{color:#FBF1E4}
  .foot-blurb{margin-top:20px;color:#DCC5B2;font-size:15.5px;max-width:32ch}
  .foot-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:22px;border:1px solid rgba(239,223,207,.35);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 15px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
  .foot-badge svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--accent-light)}
  .site-footer h3{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#D9BFAA;margin-bottom:18px}
  .site-footer li{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:9px}
  .site-footer li span.d{display:inline-block;min-width:96px;color:#D9BFAA}
  .site-footer a{text-decoration:none}
  .site-footer a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
  .foot-word{position:relative;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(5rem,19.5vw,19.5rem);line-height:.8;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:#F6E8D8;margin:96px 0 0 -.04em;white-space:nowrap;font-variation-settings:"SOFT" 100,"WONK" 1;font-weight:350;user-select:none}
  .foot-word em{color:var(--accent-light)}
  .foot-bottom{position:relative;padding:22px 0 26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(239,223,207,.22);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;font-size:13px;color:#D3B9A5;margin-top:20px}

  /* ============ Mobile bar ============ */
  .mobile-bar{display:none}

  /* ============ Motion ============ */
  @keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  @keyframes settle{from{transform:scale(1.08)}to{transform:scale(1)}}
  @keyframes ping{0%{transform:scale(.6);opacity:.9}70%,100%{transform:scale(2.1);opacity:0}}
  @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  .js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .8s var(--ease)}
  .js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
  .js .rv.d1{transition-delay:.1s}
  .js .rv.d2{transition-delay:.2s}

  /* ============ Responsive ============ */
  @media (max-width:1240px){
    .nav{gap:22px}
    .header-phone .num{display:none}
    .menu-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,340px);gap:44px}
    .carta{padding:48px 44px 40px}
  }
  @media (max-width:1080px){
    :root{--gutter:32px}
    .nav,.header-phone,.header-cta{display:none}
    .menu-toggle{display:inline-flex}
    .header-actions{margin-left:auto;gap:10px}
    .mobile-nav{display:block;position:fixed;inset:var(--header-s) 0 0 0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);padding:16px var(--gutter) 32px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateY(-8px);transition:opacity .3s var(--ease),transform .3s var(--ease),visibility .3s;overflow-y:auto;z-index:79}

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@0.469.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  var root = document.documentElement;
  root.classList.add('js');
  var reduce = window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var PH = function(id, w){ return 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-' + id + '?w=' + (w || 900) + '&q=80&auto=format&fit=crop'; };

  /* ---------- Language ---------- */
  function setLang(lang, save){
    if(lang !== 'es') lang = 'en';
    root.classList.remove('lang-en','lang-es');
    root.classList.add('lang-' + lang);
    root.lang = lang;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang-btn]').forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.getAttribute('data-lang-btn') === lang ? 'true' : 'false'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ph-' + lang + ']').forEach(function(el){ el.placeholder = el.getAttribute('data-ph-' + lang); });
    document.querySelectorAll('option[data-' + lang + '-text]').forEach(function(o){ o.textContent = o.getAttribute('data-' + lang + '-text'); });
    if(save){ try{ localStorage.setItem('wc360-lang-comida', lang); }catch(e){} }
  }
  var initial = 'en';
  try{ var stored = localStorage.getItem('wc360-lang-comida'); if(stored) initial = stored; }catch(e){}
  var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('lang');
  if(q === 'es' || q === 'en') initial = q;
  setLang(initial, false);
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang-btn]').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ setLang(b.getAttribute('data-lang-btn'), true); });
  });

  /* ---------- Icons ---------- */
  if(window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();

  /* ---------- Header: solid + compact after the hero starts scrolling ---------- */
  var header = document.querySelector('.site-header');
  var toggle = document.querySelector('.menu-toggle'), mnav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');
  function onScroll(){ header.classList.toggle('solid', window.scrollY > 40 || mnav.classList.contains('open')); }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true}); onScroll();
  function closeNav(){ mnav.classList.remove('open'); header.classList.remove('menu-open'); toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); onScroll(); }
  toggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var open = mnav.classList.toggle('open');
    header.classList.toggle('menu-open', open);
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    onScroll();
  });
  mnav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){ a.addEventListener('click', closeNav); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Escape' && mnav.classList.contains('open')){ closeNav(); toggle.focus(); } });

  /* ---------- Live open / closed status from the hours table ---------- */
  var DAYS_EN = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
  var DAYS_ES = ['domingo','lunes','martes','miércoles','jueves','viernes','sábado'];
  function toMin(s){ if(!s) return null; var p = s.split(':'); return (+p[0]) * 60 + (+p[1]); }
  function fmt(m){ var h = Math.floor(m / 60), mm = m % 60, ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'; h = h % 12 || 12; return h + (mm ? ':' + String(mm).padStart(2,'0') : '') + ' ' + ap; }
  var hours = {};
  document.querySelectorAll('#hours-table tr[data-day]').forEach(function(tr){
    hours[+tr.dataset.day] = { open: toMin(tr.dataset.open), close: toMin(tr.dataset.close), row: tr };
  });
  function updateStatus(){
    var now;
    try{ now = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/New_York' })); }catch(e){ now = new Date(); }
    var day = now.getDay(), mins = now.getHours() * 60 + now.getMinutes(), today = hours[day];
    document.querySelectorAll('#hours-table tr.today').forEach(function(r){ r.classList.remove('today'); var t = r.querySelector('.today-tag'); if(t) t.remove(); });
    if(today && today.row){
      today.row.classList.add('today');
      today.row.querySelector('th').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<span class="today-tag"><span data-en>Today</span><span data-es>Hoy</span></span>');
    }
    var en, es, isOpen = false;
    if(today && today.open !== null && mins < today.open){
      en = 'Opens today at ' + fmt(today.open); es = 'Abre hoy a las ' + fmt(today.open);
    } else if(today && today.open !== null && mins < today.close){
      isOpen = true;
      en = 'Open now · closes at ' + fmt(today.close); es = 'Abierto ahora · cierra a las ' + fmt(today.close);
    } else {
      for(var i = 1; i <= 7; i++){
        var d = (day + i) % 7, h = hours[d];
        if(h && h.open !== null){
          if(i === 1){ en = 'Closed now · opens tomorrow at ' + fmt(h.open); es = 'Cerrado ahora · abre mañana a las ' + fmt(h.open); }
          else { en = 'Closed now · opens ' + DAYS_EN[d] + ' at ' + fmt(h.open); es = 'Cerrado ahora · abre el ' + DAYS_ES[d] + ' a las ' + fmt(h.open); }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if(!en) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.js-status').forEach(function(s){
      s.querySelector('.status-text').innerHTML = '<span data-en>' + en + '</span><span data-es>' + es + '</span>';
      s.classList.toggle('closed', !isOpen);
    });
  }
  updateStatus();
  setInterval(updateStatus, 60000);

  /* ---------- Menu: tabs follow the category in view ---------- */
  var tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-tabs a');
  var tabList = document.querySelector('.menu-tabs ul');
  var cats = document.querySelectorAll('.cat');
  function activateTab(id){
    tabs.forEach(function(a){
      var on = a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id;
      a.classList.toggle('active', on);
      if(on){
        a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
        var li = a.parentNode;
        if(tabList.scrollWidth > tabList.clientWidth){ tabList.scrollTo({ left: li.offsetLeft - 20, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }); }
      } else a.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Menu: floating preview (desktop) and inline photos (touch / narrow) ---------- */
  var wide = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1081px)');
  var frame = document.querySelector('.preview-frame');
  var layers = frame ? frame.querySelectorAll('img.pv') : [];
  var front = 0, currentSrc = layers.length ? layers[0].getAttribute('src') : '';
  var pvName = document.getElementById('pv-name'), pvPrice = document.getElementById('pv-price'), pvDesc = document.getElementById('pv-desc'), pvTag = document.getElementById('pv-tag');
  var activeDish = null;
  function swapImage(src){
    if(!layers.length || src === currentSrc) return;
    currentSrc = src;
    var next = layers[1 - front], cur = layers[front];
    next.onload = function(){ if(currentSrc !== src) return; next.classList.add('show'); cur.classList.remove('show'); front = 1 - front; };
    next.src = src;
  }
  function catOf(el){ return el.closest('.cat'); }
  function showDish(li){
    if(!wide.matches || !li) return;
    var cat = catOf(li);
    swapImage(PH(li.dataset.photo || cat.dataset.photo));
    var nameEl = li.querySelector('.dish-name');
    pvName.textContent = nameEl.textContent.trim();
    pvPrice.innerHTML = li.querySelector('.price').innerHTML;
    pvDesc.innerHTML = li.querySelector('.dish-desc').innerHTML;
    pvTag.textContent = cat.querySelector('h3').textContent + (li.dataset.photo ? '' : ' · ' + (root.classList.contains('lang-es') ? 'foto de la categoría' : 'category photo'));
    if(activeDish) activeDish.classList.remove('is-active');
    activeDish = li; li.classList.add('is-active');
  }
  function showCat(cat){
    if(!wide.matches) return;
    if(activeDish && catOf(activeDish) === cat) return;
    var first = cat.querySelector('.dish[data-photo]') || cat.querySelector('.dish');
    showDish(first);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.dish').forEach(function(li){
    li.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ showDish(li); });
    var btn = li.querySelector('button.dish-name');
    if(!btn) return;
    btn.addEventListener('focus', function(){ showDish(li); });
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if(wide.matches){ showDish(li); return; }
      /* narrow screens: open the photo inline, under the dish */
      var fig = li.querySelector('.dish-fig');
      if(!fig){
        fig = document.createElement('div');
        fig.className = 'dish-fig';
        fig.id = 'fig-' + li.dataset.photo;
        fig.innerHTML = '<div><img class="ph" width="900" height="675" alt="" src="' + PH(li.dataset.photo, 800) + '"></div>';
        li.appendChild(fig);
        btn.setAttribute('aria-controls', fig.id);
        void fig.offsetHeight;
      }
      var open = !li.classList.contains('open');
      li.classList.toggle('open', open);
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  });
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var catIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(en){ if(en.isIntersecting){ activateTab(en.target.id); showCat(en.target); } });
    }, { rootMargin: '-40% 0px -55% 0px' });
    cats.forEach(function(c){ catIO.observe(c); });
    /* warm up the preview photos once the menu is close */
    var warmed = false;
    var warmIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      if(warmed || !entries[0].isIntersecting || !wide.matches) return;
      warmed = true;
      document.querySelectorAll('.dish[data-photo], .cat[data-photo]').forEach(function(el){ var i = new Image(); i.src = PH(el.dataset.photo); });
    }, { rootMargin: '600px 0px' });
    warmIO.observe(document.getElementById('menu'));
  }

  /* ---------- Catering cards pre-select the form ---------- */
  var sel = document.getElementById('f-service');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-service]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(){ sel.value = a.dataset.service; });
  });

  /* ---------- Reveal on scroll (enhancement only) ---------- */
  var rv = document.querySelectorAll('.rv');
  if(!reduce && 'IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(en){ if(en.isIntersecting){ en.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(en.target); } });
    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.08 });
    rv.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    rv.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  /* ---------- Demo form ---------- */
  document.querySelector('.form').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var btn = this.querySelector('button[type=submit]');
    btn.innerHTML = root.classList.contains('lang-es') ? 'Gracias. Te contactamos hoy mismo' : 'Thanks. We’ll get back to you today';
    btn.disabled = true;
  });
})();
</script>
